target.statement: Our method achieves Bleu-3 = 0.0644 on the Reddit conversation dataset (Table 2, 'Ours' row).

compute.basis: Training on 3.38M Reddit pairs with 8 V100 GPUs takes ~1.5h/epoch; on a CPU-only laptop this is infeasible, and the paper's own code is not released.

blockers: No code release for the proposed method (only baseline ConceptFlow code is linked)
Requires training on 3.38M dialogue pairs, which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop
Requires rebuilding the enhanced graph (GIZA++ alignment, ConceptNet merge) from scratch
Data access for the preprocessed Reddit dataset is not directly linked and may require manual reconstruction
title: Guiding Topic Flows in the Generative Chatbot by Enhancing the ConceptNet with the Conversation Corpora
